sources.entry: Claude Accounts - Switches the Claude desktop app between your accounts with one click, without losing sessions. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jomonkj/claude-accounts) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: An unofficial macOS menu bar app that saves each Claude desktop app login and switches between your accounts with one click, without re-signing in.
summary.what_it_does: The app saves the login files of each Claude desktop app account and loads them back when you switch, so you do not have to sign out and sign in again. A switch quits Claude, saves the current login, loads the chosen one, reopens Claude, and checks that the login works. It can sync session lists between accounts you mark as yours, with a preview and a backup first, and never deletes sessions. It lists sessions that stopped on a usage limit with the reset time, and an optional live usage view (off by default) reads per-limit percentages from claude.ai. Logins are saved with daily backups, a restore option, and a journal that recovers an interrupted switch. A command-line pair (claude-accounts and claude-switch) gives the same actions from a terminal.
use_cases: switch between work and personal Claude accounts
keep Claude desktop sessions across several logins
sync chat sessions between my own accounts
see which account hit the usage limit and when it resets
back up and restore Claude desktop login state
check live 5-hour and weekly usage per account
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash (one-command install, script URL is blank in the README)
Or download Claude-Accounts .zip from the latest release, move Claude Accounts to Applications, and right-click → Open the first time
scripts/install.sh (build from source: runs all tests, builds for this Mac, installs)
scripts/build.sh (universal build into ./build; ARCHS=arm64 for a fast one)
claude-switch switch aaaa1111 (switch by account ID or first 8 characters)
stack: macOS Keychain (Claude Safe Storage key, used only for live usage)
notable: Copies login files as they are, without decrypting cookies or reading the Keychain for normal switching
Journal-based switch with a recover command that rolls back or finishes an interrupted switch
Two-way session sync between accounts marked as yours, never deletes, and never touches accounts not marked as yours
Optional live usage per limit from claude.ai, off by default, with a warning at 90%
Crash and sync property tests in the repo (tests/crash_test.sh, tests/sync_property_test.py)
caveats: Unofficial, not made by or affiliated with Anthropic; relies on how the Claude desktop app stores its files, and a layout check stops the switch if an update changes them
Not notarized by Apple, so the first launch needs right-click → Open, and the installer removes the quarantine flag
Live usage uses an undocumented claude.ai request that can change at any time, and it needs one-time Keychain access; it is off by default
Requires macOS 14 or later; switches only the Claude desktop app, not the claude CLI in a terminal; a switch stops running Claude tasks
